notes: Wheel track is a provisional calculation input, not a selected motor/wheel layout.
Axle midpoint is assumed to coincide with the center of the rectangular robot footprint.
Only straight forward/reverse and in-place spin primitives are used; no curved turns, slip, acceleration or actuator limits are modeled.
Each route connects assumed start pose, one illustrative divider circuit, assigned pit-box docking, reverse withdrawal, and return to race staging. It is not a complete legal competition mission.
Constant global position/heading perturbations in the inherited sweep are footprint-clearance stress tests, not integrated differential-drive odometry errors.
